svg.title: CBTC end-to-end system architecture
svg.desc: Three-tier CBTC architecture: a central ATS layer, a wayside layer of zone controllers and interlocking, and an onboard layer built around the VOBC, with the external systems that sit outside the IEC 62290 system boundary behind defined interfaces.

g.text: CBTC SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE · ATC = ATP + ATO + ATS
Three tiers, one authority hierarchy: ATP > ATO > ATS.
TRACK · BALISES AT FIXED POINTS PROVIDE ABSOLUTE POSITION REFERENCE

svg.text: REFRESHED EVERY 200–500 ms OVER THE DCS

g.text: The IEC 62290 system boundary contains ATP, ATO and ATS only. Everything in the dashed column is external infrastructure reached through an Interface Control Document —
and interface scope, not core CBTC function, is what most often moves a project's schedule.
